documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V1.0: PLA Glow
Bambu PLA Glow Safety Data Sheet SDS20251127A12
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA Glow
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 26 ± 3 MPa, elongation 6.5 ± 0.8 %, bending modulus 2230 ± 110 MPa, bending strength 55 ± 3 MPa, impact 19.8 ± 1.8 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density, melting and glass transition temperatures are raw-material properties (ISO 1183, DSC) and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2030 ± 210 MPa, Z 1750 ± 180 MPa), melt index (23.3 ± 2.4 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), crystallization temperature ("/"), heat deflection temperature 55 °C at 0.45 MPa, saturated water absorption rate (0.46 % at 25 °C, 55% RH), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH, sealed with desiccant), bed surface preparation (glue), retraction length (0.6 - 1.0 mm) and speed (20 - 40 mm/s), chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C), max overhang angle (~ 55°), max bridging length (30 mm), support material (Support for PLA), spool material (PC + ABS, temperature resistance 90 °C) and spool size (diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), suggested annealing (50 to 60 °C, 6 to 12 hours), odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products rows.
The TDS recommended chamber temperature (25 - 45 °C) is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is a printer capability (number, template field chamber_temp_max), not a filament print setting.
The TDS "Bed Surface Preparation Glue" is a recommended setting, not a stated requirement, so no "requires" relation is written.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: model "A12-xx", CLP "Not classified", and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO-TI/IATA-DGR) transport. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values.
Nozzle temperature disagreement left to review: TDS p.1 "190 - 230 °C" (stored) against the material-table wiki row "PLA Glow" "210 - 240" (±10 °C).

AMS disagreement left to review: the store page says "AMS 2 Pro, AMS HT & AMS Compatible, but can lead to faster wear"; the material-table wiki rates PLA Glow's AMS / AMS lite compatibility "Not Recommended". AMS lite is not compatible in every source.

The material-table wiki's "PLA" rows (bed temperatures, drying, storage) are for standard PLA; PLA Glow has its own rows in the nozzle and AMS tables and is named among the particle-filled materials, so the "PLA" values are not applied to this product.

Marketing prose proves no number: "Unique Glow in Low Light Conditions", "exceptional overall mechanical properties" (TDS Basic Info) and the store FAQ's "approximately 2 hours" of ultraviolet or sunlight to rejuvenate the glow are not stored as values.
Hex: all 5 store colours have exactly one hex cell, matched by the colour name without the code in parentheses. The table states the hex is the daytime colour.

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/2c7b9c30a9014c65bb4aeacd9c70e6af.pdf) that was not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published.
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 3); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).
The store FAQ (4.Safety Tips) says the filament "is not food-grade"; no registry key holds it.

Adjudication against the second extraction (107 field disagreements), each disputed fact re-read in the cached TDS, SDS, hex table, PLA wiki, material-table wiki and store page. Same fact, this file's form kept: the locator wording of every TDS row and hex cell ("p.N, Section › Row"; "p.1, row N, column M" for the hex cells); material.net_weight as 1 kg, the TDS's own figure (the merge stores 1000 g, text "1 kg", as the second extraction's 1000 g would); the hardened-steel nozzle, AMS lite and 0.2 mm nozzle relations on the store page's Cautions for Use bullets (the material-table and PLA wiki rows the second extraction cited are in their notes); the reviewed compat-targets.json handles ams-lite, ams-2-pro, ams-ht and ams-multicolor-printing (the second extraction left them empty); the high-flow nozzle relation on the PLA wiki row "PLA Glow" with the class label "High-flow nozzles (0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm)" (the material-table row's three high flow columns are in its note); one all_bambu_printers family relation for the open-frame and enclosed printer columns, not two. Kept against it: material.type "Polylactic acid", the TDS p.3 Composition cell itself, not the abbreviation "PLA"; thermal.heat_deflection_temp the 1.8 MPa row (52 °C), as in every other filament file, the 0.45 MPa row (55 °C) in its test_condition; print_settings.print_speed verified text "< 250 mm/s" (a labelled TDS row, no lower bound invented), as in every other filament file; material.spool_type the store bullet "Basic Reusable Spool" (unverified), since the TDS Spool Material and Spool Size rows give the spool's material and size, not its type. Kept though absent from the second extraction, each re-read in the TDS p.1: the compatible_with relation "0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm nozzles" (Nozzle Size row) and the Cool, High Temperature and Textured PEI plate relations (Build Plate Type row). Taken from the second extraction after reading the documents: extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters [0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm] (TDS p.1 "Nozzle Size 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 mm", as in the PLA Marble and PLA-CF files) and not_compatible_with "Hotend with Stainless Steel Nozzle 0.2mm" (store FAQ, 1.Accessory Compatibility, as in the PLA Translucent file). Not taken: a separate "Brass nozzle" relation (the material-table guideline "Do not use a stainless steel or brass nozzle." covers a class of particle-filled materials; this product's own sources state the hardened-steel requirement, which is the requires relation, and no other filament file carries a brass row).
